metadata.summary: Max Dowman has waited patiently for opportunities in Arsenal's first team, but when he gets them, he delivers.
metadata.content: Max Dowman: Arsenal prodigy delivers latest statement performance as Mikel Arteta urges caution over 16-year-old | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Max Dowman: Arsenal prodigy delivers latest statement performance as Mikel Arteta urges caution over 16-year-old Max Dowman scored twice for Arsenal in their 4-2 win at Ipswich Town in the Carabao Cup third round; the 16-year-old forward was making his first appearance of the season; Dowman has had to wait for his chance after becoming the Premier League's youngest scorer David Richardson Football Journalist Wednesday 16 September 2026 06:14, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Max Dowman opened the scoring with a clinical finish against Ipswich Max Dowman has waited patiently for opportunities in Arsenal's first team, but when he gets them, he delivers. Mikel Arteta has managed the prodigy carefully since his big moment last season, when he became the Premier League's youngest scorer in a vital 2-0 home win over Everton on their title charge. Dowman has played six times since then, mostly in cameos, and has been an unused substitute on four occasions this season. Last Saturday, he played an hour for the U21s in their 4-1 defeat to Chelsea while the first team won at Sunderland. Arteta warned Dowman afterwards that he must earn his minutes this season.
